name: Martini 2.2 proteins
references: S. J. Marrink et al., J. Phys. Chem. B 111, 7812 (2007)
L. Monticelli et al., J. Chem. Theory Comput. 4, 819 (2008)
D. H. de Jong et al., J. Chem. Theory Comput. 9, 687 (2013)
P. C. Kroon et al., Martinize2 and Vermouth, eLife 12, RP90627 (2023)
notes: an all-atom protein is mapped onto Martini 2.2 beads with martinize's explicit topology (data/martini/martini22-protein.json; DSSP for the secondary structure)
bead types, masses and every pair from martini_v2.2.itp (C6 / C12 as epsilon = C6^2 / 4 C12, sigma = (C12 / C6)^(1/6))
run settings as MARTINI 2 in the library: lj/gromacs 9 to 12 A, coul/gromacs 1e-6 to 12 A, relative permittivity 15, special_bonds 0 1 1
constraints are stiff bonds (20000 kJ/mol/nm2): CAPS has no constraints
